Props are read-only inputs received from a parent; state is component-owned memory managed by React.
Props parent එJකන් එන data. State component එක ඇතුJළේ manage කරන Jවනස් විය හැකි data.
A counter receives its title as a prop and owns its count as state.
Parent title prop · Counter count state · Child reads title Setter schedules update
Read the diagram: Props are controlled by the parent, while the component updates state through a setter.
Expected result: Click changes count from 0 to 1; title remains the parent's input.

Interview question: Can a child directly modify its props?
Answer: No. Ask the parent to update its data through a callback.
Practice: Add a reset button to Counter.
